accepted.title: Agent 64: Spies Never Die — Shacknews review
accepted.identity_evidence: Critic review for Agent 64: Spies Never Die attributed by Metacritic to Shacknews.
evidence_points: Agent 64: Spies Never Die is a fun shooter that goes above and beyond to act as an accurate facsimile of Nintendo 64 shooters, particularly Goldeneye. There’s even a really nice CRT filter that captures the mid-tier monitor look you may have seen often if you were around at the time. Sometimes this thing is accurate to a fault, depending on your perspective when it comes to modern conventions and “QoL” features. Sometimes it’s a little too self-indulgent when it comes to pushing mastery, when it comes to simply letting players go through the story like the adults with jobs they probably are. But that’s the picture Agent 64 is painting, and in that case the project is completed with flying co
